description: This file defines a class 'VersionAPI' that extends another class to handle API requests related to version information within the installation API namespace of the OrangeHRM project. It mainly overrides the handleGet method to modify request parameters before delegating to the parent implementation.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A class that handles API requests related to software version information within the installation process, extending functionality from a parent API class.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the parent handleGet method to set an 'excludeLatest' parameter on the request's query object, then calls the parent method to process the request.
